environment.browser: one headless Chromium worker; precise JS heap sampling at 500 ms

method: Five samples per version/standard size; independent backend process, database and verified browser pair per sample.
Version order alternates; size order rotates. One stack/sample at a time.
Warm HTTP service after fixture creation, first protected-file transfer on that fixture.
selectionMs includes Playwright file payload installation and draft rendering.
sendMs is click to Sent UI assertion, not a delivery receipt. Assertions have polling granularity.
completeToSentMs is a proxy including post-complete checks, encrypted outbox publication, rendering and assertion overhead.
downloadReadyMs includes authenticated download, decoding, AES-GCM verification, temporary output and Save-link assertion.
crypto metrics cover attachment WebCrypto operations only; exclude base64, key import and manifest encoding.
HTTP headersMs excludes response-body read; observedRetryWaitMs follows only matched same-method/URL retries kept in memory, never exported.
Heap values are sampled JS heap, not full renderer/WASM/RSS peaks.
Large exploratory and sustained samples are separate from the n=5 isolated comparison.
